posts.content:
🧵 Our story: When your 4-year-old gets diagnosed with T1D, everything changes. As a T1D dad myself, I thought I knew what we were facing.

I was wrong. 30 years between diagnoses. Same disease, completely different world.

1/7
posts.media_notes: Photo of AVA bear with glucose meter

posts.content:
2/7 When I was diagnosed in 1994, we had:
• Finger pricks 8x/day
• Urine strips 
• NPH insulin that peaked whenever it felt like it
• 'Diabetic' food (🤢)
• A glucose meter the size of a brick

Survival mode.

posts.content:
Meet AVA 🐻

The companion that makes T1D management less scary for kids. Built by a T1D dad who remembers being the scared kid.

Real-time glucose alerts, gentle reminders, and always there when you need her.

#AVAType1 #T1D #DiabetesTech

posts.content:
T1D education time 📚

Myth: "You can't eat sugar if you have diabetes"
Reality: You can eat anything - you just need to dose insulin correctly for it.

The goal isn't restriction, it's education and empowerment.

#T1D #DiabetesEducation
